task: Ticket booking with a transactional outbox: Database port + in-memory adapter, BookingService, OutboxRelay (per-key order, backoff, dead-letter) and IdempotentReceiver
reasoning_summary: Designed four packages with inward dependencies; the Database port runs work atomically on a working copy so the business write and outbox row commit together. The relay calls the sink outside any transaction, keeps per-key order by stopping a key at its first failure, and dead-letters after maxAttempts. Verified with literal backoff times, lost-ack redelivery, a seeded randomised oracle test and a concurrency test.
